Is another 6 figure 3L .com about to expire?

Similar story to OKS (see reply link) which recently sold at auction for $112K.

Here is what happened...

ILR (Industrial Laser Review) .com was owned by PennWell Publishing Company (registered in 1995).

2000s they began 301ing the domain to various laser related URLS (ex: industrial-lasers .com). Sloppy SEO.

2018 PennWell acquired by Clarion (backed by Blackstone Investments), domain gets "lost" in transition.

2023-2024 domain shows up as "for sale" by Saw Brokers.

It appears that several laser related names from same portfolio are about to expire, while others are active.

Pilfered by employee or forgotten asset?
